original_post_text:
DEVELOPING | The Lodge Card Club

Word is spreading fast through the Austin poker community and an official reopening announcement could be coming as early as tomorrow.

The doors have been temporarily closed since the March raid, but chatter in Austin circles is heating up. Stay locked in and let’s see if the rumors are true. 

Follow for updates. Share if you're watching.

#TheLodge #TexasPoker #TheShamReport #AustinPoker
expanded_title: Developing: Austin Poker Chatter Heats Up Ahead of The Lodge Card Club’s Reopening Announcement
expanded_deck: Days after the Williamson County grand jury no-bill, word spread fast through Austin poker circles that an official reopening announcement from The Lodge Card Club could arrive within 24 hours.
expanded_body:
Originally posted May 3, 2026.

DEVELOPING | The Lodge Card Club

Word is spreading fast through the Austin poker community that an official reopening announcement could be coming as early as tomorrow.

The doors have been temporarily closed since the March 10 raid, but following the Williamson County grand jury's April 28 no-bill, chatter in Austin circles is heating up. Stay locked in and let's see if the rumors are true.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams

fact_verification_flags.claim: Austin community reports on May 3, 2026 anticipated an imminent reopening announcement from The Lodge Card Club following the April 28 grand jury no-bill
fact_verification_flags.note: Reported as developing community chatter on May 3, 2026; The Lodge subsequently reopened in May 2026.
